_comment: Registry of validate cells (DAG nodes / test targets) with MEASURED instability. A single FAILED on a cell listed here is a weighted coin-flip, not proof of a defect: per the false-red-durability rule, such a red must be RE-RUN SOLO AT -j4 before it is written as a FAILURE. Add a cell ONLY with a measured pass/fail sample and its provenance; do not list a cell on suspicion. `ci-hub/validate/flake_class.py` consumes this to reclassify a fail -> needs-rerun.

cells.note: common_commands_are_deterministic_under_strict_verify: 9 PASS / 1 FAIL of 10 under identical conditions. Live instance 3a404879 (portable CI DAG manifest fail@221s) was this single-tail failure.
